value.rationale: Pinpoints the exact n^{-2} saturation window at which a dense geometric graph collapses to finitely many missing edges, shows a surprisingly independent-edge universal law despite geometric dependence, and quantifies the entire information content through the constant term. This moving-radius regime is explicitly outside recent fixed-radius geometric-entropy results, and the exact entropy of near-complete labeled networks is a natural statistic rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
